claims.statement: For the full Fourier law pi of any nonconstant uniform-cube Boolean function in the fixed centered gauge, let v=Pr_pi[X nonempty], q_i=Pr_pi[i in X], let P=pi conditioned nonempty, let Q_r be the exact maximum-entropy nonempty I-projection with r_i=q_i/v and parameter c, and lift Q_r back to the full law by preserving empty mass. For every selector alpha on ordered pairs independent of X, v K_occ >= sum_{i!=j} alpha_ij d_2(s_ij || (c/v)q_iq_j). Using the source co-pair identity omega_{i<-j}=4s_ij-2c_{i<-j}, this implies v K_occ >= sum alpha_ij Psi_{(c/v)q_iq_j}(omega_{i<-j}), where Psi_b(omega)=d_2(omega/4||b) for omega>4b and 0 otherwise.
claims.scope: Uniform-cube Boolean functions; fixed median/character gauge used by the co-pair source; one randomized selected physical pair. This is not an additive sum over all pair projections.
claims.proof: REPORT.md Sections 2-4; lifted I-projection identity plus KL data processing and monotonicity of Bernoulli KL.

dependencies.result: Exact nonempty occurrence I-projection Q_r and K_occ=D(P||Q_r).
Path-C hidden-curvature bank U4 and explicit tensor-centered/nonreusing payment gap.

claims.statement: The exact pair reference seen by K_occ after restoring the true empty spectral mass is b_ij=(c/v)q_iq_j, not q_iq_j in general. The two coincide exactly when c=v.

For f(a,b,c,d)=(-1)^(ab+cd), all 16 Walsh squares are 1/16, v=c=15/16, q_i=1/2, K_occ=0, and for a cross-factor pair s=b=1/4 while the source tensor formula gives omega=1=4b. Thus raw hidden orientation can be positive with zero occurrence KL; the baseline subtraction is necessary.
claims.scope: One explicit genuine four-bit Boolean tensor; not a terminal critical core and not a counterexample to FEI.

remaining_implication: TERMINAL-SELECTOR-TO-KL: construct a realizable state-dependent pair selector on every uncovered ratio-critical terminal branch whose exact selected-pair KL charge controls the still-unpaid trigger/entropy deficit with a dimension-independent constant, while the conditional-product baseline is separately absorbed by tensor-centered criticality or forces an affordable block.
